description: For subcontractor work order, this completion sign-off form records deliverables, inclusions, exclusions, quantities, materials, interfaces, safety duties, cleanup, and payment terms. Its supporting evidence includes scope exhibits, drawings, quote, qualification record, schedule commitment, and compliance documents.

blocks.guidance: Link this subcontractor work order record to its evidence.

blocks.guidance: Do not mobilize without executed terms, required insurance, approved safety readiness, access, and prerequisite release. Route unresolved subcontractor work order work for review.

title: Subcontractor Work Order Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during subcontractor work-order scoping and release when the subcontractor work order record must identify project, trade package, work locations, contract references, schedule window, site contacts, and insurance status. Complete the applicable handoff for authorized work order, notice to proceed, distribution, change protocol, progress reporting, and closeout duties.
